text:
support_jen: Hey team, received an escalation from AcmePago — they say their chat assistant started giving shorter/incomplete answers after today's rollout. Customer believes it's tied to the tokenizer + chat template change. Repro attached.
ml_infra_sam: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro and whether they use Redwood hosted or Dedicated? :eyes:
support_jen: Hosted (us-east). Repro steps from customer: 1) call /v1/chat with system+user messages using our old template vs new template 2) compare outputs. They sent exact curl.
customer_ops_ben: they included example responses showing the assistant dropped a safety-preface we used to see. They flagged ~15% of conversations with different completions.
support_jen: here's the curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Explain how to reset a router"}] }'
```
ml_infra_sam: can we get the before/after raw tokenization? ask customer for the token lists. Could be whitespace normalization.
runtime_dev_lee: hmm we pushed a small tokenizer normalization in the hosted runtime that changes how leading newlines and role prefixes are tokenized; it was supposed to be no-op for most templates. :grimacing: Will dig.
product_ana: linking to the rollout: deploy-bot: rolled out tokenizer-normalize v2 to us-east at 2026-03-15T08:12:03Z
support_jen: customer provided diffs: (old output) vs (new output). Old: "Sure — to reset your router, follow these steps..." New: "Reset router steps:\n1. Power cycle..." They lose the friendly phrasing and a short safety note about not sharing creds.
ml_infra_sam: that points to a token boundary issue where system prefix tokens that triggered a polite-safety template are split differently; downstream rerank/templating picked different prefix probabilities.
runtime_dev_lee: reproducing locally now. Quick test: feed the same messages, dump byte-level tokens (using our tokenizer debug flag). If token lists differ, this is on us.
support_jen: customer-run token lists (sanitized):
Old tokens: ["<|system|>", "You", " are", " a", " helpful", " assistant.", "\n", "Explain", " how", " to", " reset", " a", " router"]
New tokens: ["<|system|>", "You are a helpful assistant.\nExplain", " how to reset a router"]
ml_infra_sam: aha — token merge across the newline. That will change attention patterns and maybe cause the safety-turn to be less prominent.
product_ana: Is the change limited to merging across role delimiters? Any regressions expected for few-shot prompts?
runtime_dev_lee: merging tokens across the newline was a side-effect of the normalization rule that collapses consecutive whitespace and joins short chunks. It improved average token count but altered segmentation.
ml_infra_sam: we need an immediate mitigation: 1) roll back normalization in us-east for hosted, or 2) add a compatibility shim that forces explicit role separator tokens. Which is faster?
runtime_dev_lee: rollback is fast but will cause a small spike in billed tokens. Shim requires a quick server-side rewrite of chat templates to insert explicit `\n<|sep|>\n` markers; I can push that in ~2 hours.
support_jen: customer asked for rollback, they're sensitive because they A/B test assistant tone.
product_ana: recommend rollback to be safe. We must notify customers and run windowed canary.
ml_infra_sam: agree — I'll start the rollback plan on Dedicated control plane and coordinate with infra. Marking P2.
deploy-bot: rollback: tokenizer-normalize v2 -> v1 scheduled, initiating canary 2 nodes in us-east at 2026-03-15T08:40:00Z
support_jen: copying customer: we apologized and said we're investigating; offered rollback. They want to wait until we confirm token-level cause.
runtime_dev_lee: current local repro logs: token counts before: 12, after normalize: 7; model logits for safety token span dropped by ~0.6 logits. Pasting mini log:
```
[DEBUG] input_tokens_before=["You"," are"," a"," helpful"," assistant.","\n","Explain",... ]
[DEBUG] input_tokens_after=["You are a helpful assistant.\nExplain"," how",...]
[DEBUG] safety_tok_logit_before=1.8
[DEBUG] safety_tok_logit_after=1.2
```
ml_infra_sam: that delta matches customer-reported drop in safety-preface presence. Not great.
product_ana: action items: rollback hosted us-east immediate; create patch to add explicit separators to chat templates; notify customers; postmortem if we don't catch more.
support_jen: I'll coordinate communication and get the customer a repro run after rollback.
customer_ops_ben: also flag to CS that this may affect tone for other clients.
ml_infra_sam: filing internal ticket INF-2026 with links to logs and customer repro + assign to runtime_dev_lee.
support_jen: thanks all. If runtime team can confirm rollback ETA I'll update customer.
runtime_dev_lee: rollback completed on canary at 2026-03-15T08:52Z, full us-east rollback in progress, ETA 18 minutes. Will post final verification logs when done.
support_jen: noted, will follow up with AcmePago after confirmation. :thumbsup:
